definitions.gloss: to delay, to make late, to postpone
definitions.explanation: To cause something to happen later than scheduled or expected. Causative form of {遅|おく}れる (to be late).

examples.japanese: {出発|しゅっぱつ}を{一時間|いちじかん}{遅|おく}らせた。
examples.english: We delayed the departure by one hour.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}を{来週|らいしゅう}まで{遅|おく}らせてください。
examples.english: Please postpone the meeting until next week.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{雨|あめ}で{遅|おく}らせることになった。
examples.english: The construction was delayed due to rain.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Causative form of {遅|おく}れる. Pattern: Xを{遅|おく}らせる (delay X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resultative state. {遅|おく}らせている = 'is being delayed / has been delayed.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{出発|しゅっぱつ}を{遅|おく}らせる (delay departure)
・{会議|かいぎ}を{遅|おく}らせる (postpone a meeting)
・{締|し}め{切|き}りを{遅|おく}らせる (extend a deadline)

RELATED:
・{遅|おく}れる - to be late (intransitive)
・{遅|おく}い - slow, late (adjective)
・{延期|えんき}する - to postpone (more formal)
